args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, here are the Marrow Agrisupply sites I found in #central-team:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The file labels doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so this needs sorting before anyone reimports.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template (10:50 AM).
3. *Wichita store*, possibly: you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" in the Zoom room that was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. The message doesn't actually say it's a Marrow store, so please confirm before you use it.

Your 10:44 AM message on 9 Jun says Marrow's tracker screenshot had three rows marked just "waiting." The channel doesn't name those stores, so they may be other sites. The Tulsa hub in that channel belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow, so I left it out. I only looked in #central-team.
